## Frozen document-independent launcher literal carrier

The fresh Science disposable parent must not read any repository document to
obtain the launcher. Its parent source contains exactly one single-quoted ASCII
scalar constant whose value is the following uninterrupted `2,668`-character
canonical Base64 string. The line below is the value to embed, not a block for
the parent to discover or extract at runtime:

```text launcher-base64-v1

```

Carrier identity is exact:

```text
base64AsciiLength=2668
base64AsciiSha256=02c0219793c0aeb6e8e989aac9f9ee52373598cdbc2a33da4f2c54b069796af9
decodedByteLength=2001
decodedSha256=96feaf7e62fa89e8c80cc46d38425d465cf845ffbd426405a75c73c056314212
decodedFinalLF=true
```

At `LAUNCHER_EXTRACT`, the parent checks its already-compiled literal's ASCII
length/hash and canonical Base64 syntax, calls `Convert.FromBase64String`
exactly once, and requires decode/re-encode equality. Any carrier or Base64
failure maps to `LAUNCHER_EXTRACT`. At `LAUNCHER_IDENTITY`, it requires exact
decoded length/hash, final byte `0x0A`, no `0x0D`, strict BOM-free UTF-8
round-trip, and decodes to one scalar `System.String`. No repository read,
artifact path, document byte slice, line range, fence, regex, search, alternate
carrier, reconstruction, repair, or second decode/extraction path exists.

This correction supersedes only the `FRSH-005-v1-VR-14` launcher fenced-capture
instruction. Its scalar launcher use, independent identity operation, parser,
